results.heading: To someone standing at the edge of the court,
results.firstParagraph: I joined a Saturday badminton session and spent the first ten minutes pretending to tie my shoes. Everyone seemed to have a partner already. Mine were tied. I checked them again.

results.heading: To someone who wants to help,
results.firstParagraph: We spent longer making the book donation poster than we did talking to the reading room. I know because I made the poster. There were several font discussions.

results.heading: To someone with a very familiar feed,
results.firstParagraph: A friend borrowed my phone to find a recipe and asked why I watched so many videos of people tidying desks. Fair question. My own desk has a cup on it that I'm scared to investigate.

results.firstParagraph: Our student magazine had eleven files called some version of FINAL. I was checking captions on a Sunday night when someone uploaded FINAL_ACTUALLY_FINAL. I nearly threw my phone.

results.heading: To the person who checks the score first,
results.firstParagraph: My little sister showed me a drawing of the moon. I asked if it was homework. Nope. A competition? Also nope. She'd just felt like drawing the moon.

results.heading: To anyone starting over,
results.firstParagraph: I changed courses last semester. On the first Monday, I went to my old building by mistake. Got halfway up the stairs, checked my phone, and had to turn around. Great start.
